label: replication rerun
study: Census Bureau ACS 2019-2023 table B19083: state Gini index of household income
target: 12 pre-set states' published Gini (WY VT DE NM MS AZ GA MI NY TX CA NC)
rule: Round 66 criterion (d30d7ed): replicated when the median |PUMS - published| <= .005 and >= 10 of 12 PUMS 90% intervals contain the published value.

original.note: Round 66 primary: household income x ADJINC, negatives set to zero, TYPEHUGQ 1, NP > 0 (estimates stored to 5 decimals)

tolerance.text: each state's Gini within .0005 of Round 66
